purpose: Retain source evidence for curation. Exclude case/accident subjects and victim-context names from distributed assets; retain independently sourced public-career/historical names even with victim flags. A historical birth date alone is insufficient. No claim to detect every incident or disambiguate all homonyms.

selectors.body: ?item wdt:P8032 ?victim. FILTER(EXISTS { ?item wdt:P585 ?date } || EXISTS { ?item wdt:P580 ?date }) FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q5 }
VALUES ?relation { dbp:victim dbp:victims } ?item ?relation ?victim; a dbo:Event. ?victim a dbo:Person.
?item a dbo:Event. VALUES ?metric { dbp:fatalities dbp:injuries dbp:deaths dbo:numberOfDeaths dbo:numberOfInjured } ?item ?metric ?count. FILTER(isNumeric(?count) && ?count > 0)
